verdict.rationale: Elastic documents vendor-maintained Elastic Agent, managed centrally through Fleet and able to run inside containers, plus 400–550+ out-of-the-box integrations. These cover servers, VMs, containers, Kubernetes clusters and cloud services, and Elastic also ships its own OpenTelemetry distribution (EDOT). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and in-depth setup docs for the Kubernetes and cloud-service integrations rather than overview-level statements.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can instrument hosts, containers, Kubernetes, and cloud services through vendor-maintained agents and integrations

citations.quote: Monitor metrics from servers, virtual machines, containers, and serverless environments with over 400 out-of-the-box integrations, including OpenTelemetry.
Monitor Kubernetes clusters, VM hosts, and cloud services with ready-to-use integrations.
Install an Elastic Agent and use Fleet to define, configure, and manage your agents in a central location.
Run an Elastic Agent inside of a container — either with Fleet Server or standalone.
Connect your data with 550+ one-click [integrations](/integrations/data-integrations) across clouds, CI/CD, databases, and more.
